purpose: Asgarnia-focused regional skilling audit: fill permanent unlocks, reward shops, guilds, farming patches, and no-trade infrastructure missing or only thinly covered after progression-enrichment-regional-skilling-2026-07-25 (artisans partial row) and outfits (Flash Powder Factory herblore outfits). Ironman / Equilibrium area pages and base-game geography.

policy.region_rule: region_hint marks where the unlock or activity lives in the current planner taxonomy. region_hints marks a cross-region chain. Quest auto-completion and League-specific overrides must be applied separately. Equilibrium Area Asgarnia explicitly includes Falador, Port Sarim, Taverley, Burthorpe, Troll Stronghold, God Wars Dungeon approach, Ice Mountain, Rimmington, Entrana, and The Arc.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise unlocks that materially change self-sufficient progression, training throughput, supply access, or tool progression. Do not mirror every shop item.
policy.rate_rule: Do not promote stale XP/hour figures. Training rates belong in training datasets; this file records unlock state and effects.
policy.combat_exclusion: Warriors' Guild is combat-token / defender infrastructure — not modeled here. God Wars Dungeon combat drops are out of scope; GWD approach is only mentioned where it is pure geography for Asgarnia access. Arc combat contracts stay combat catalogs.

activity_additions.name: Artisans' Workshop full permanent reward stack
activity_additions.location: Falador south-east — Egil's Artisans' Workshop Reward Shop
requirements: Smithing activity inside Artisans' Workshop to earn Respect (about 1% Respect per 10,000 Smithing XP while smithing there; max 100% banked at once)
Prior Solemn Smith / Ceremonial Swordsmith tiers to buy the next tier
Golden Cannon before Royale Cannon; Royale Cannon before Restocking Cannon
unlocks: Quick repairs (burst pipes 50% faster)
Repair expert (+50 Smithing XP on burst-pipe repairs)
Solemn Smith I–V (+1% burial-armour set XP each; stacks to +5%)
Ceremonial Swordsmith I–V (+1% ceremonial-sword XP each; stacks to +5%)
Ceremonial Sword Orders (+10% chance for a ceremonial sword design)
Golden / Royale dwarf multicannon capacity upgrades (60 / 90 balls)
Restocking Cannon auto-reload while balls remain in inventory and in sight
Blacksmith's outfit pieces including helmet add-on (up to 6% Smithing XP)
Luminite injectors (consumable workshop overload: +1 progress per swing for all players in the workshop)
Sword Polishing Kit consumables for ceremonial swords
activity_additions.notes: Expands the thin asgarnia:artisans-workshop-rewards row. Cosmetic Necturion/Invictum/Aetherium wardrobe unlocks are not planner-critical. Work on Your Artisan / II track full shop clearance. Respect only from smithing (not smelting, cannonballs, or protean bars).
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Asgarnia infrastructure. Burial XP multipliers and blacksmith outfit are permanent no-trade Smithing pressure, not only a training method label.

activity_additions.name: Artisans' Workshop burial equipment hub
requirements: 40+ Smithing for burial equipment path (higher metals scale to Primal)
Highest +X upgrade tier for the metal before burial conversion
unlocks: Burial equipment conversion (destroys finished +X gear for high Smithing XP with no extra bars)
Burial armour sets for +5% base XP on full suits
Ceremonial sword design random events while smithing in the workshop
Burst-pipe repair side content for Respect and Smithing XP
Bank chest and forges/furnaces colocated with Mining Guild metal-bank loop
activity_additions.notes: This is the primary high-level Smithing XP infrastructure for ironmen. Pair with Solemn Smith permanent upgrades and luminite injectors. Mining Guild sits across the street for ore-to-metal-bank throughput.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Asgarnia owns the hub. Ore and bar supply may still pull other regions.

activity_additions.name: Masterwork melee plate / glorious-bar smithing chain
requirements: 99 Smithing
It Should Have Been Called Aetherium (full elder rune +5 armour set)
Alloy progression: concentrated → enriched → immaculate → 1,001 folds → glorious bars → masterwork melee plates → curved plates → armour pieces
unlocks: Masterwork melee armour production path
Curved masterwork melee plates as intermediate materials
Skilling-adjacent masterwork intermediates used by other chains (e.g. Orthen furnace core pressure on curved plates)
Trimmed masterwork upgrade path after base set (combat-facing; keep as production gate awareness)
activity_additions.notes: Smithing is performed at anvils/forges; Artisans' Workshop is the natural Asgarnia smithing home for respect + metal bank. Masterwork itself is a global recipe once 99 Smithing is unlocked, but Asgarnia is the practical workshop/metal-bank geography ironman guides cluster with Mining Guild and LRC.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Treat Asgarnia as the smithing infrastructure region; do not claim every ore source is Asgarnia-local.

75 Agility

activity_additions.name: Mining Guild
activity_additions.location: South-east Falador surface complex + southern Dwarven Mine underground
requirements: 60 Mining to enter (boostable; e.g. dwarven stout from 59)
unlocks: Guild coal, runite, and orichalcite rock cluster
Colocation with Artisans' Workshop for metal-bank smithing loop
Gadrin Mining skillcape seller at 99 Mining
Skills necklace / Dungeoneering cape access patterns into the guild
activity_additions.notes: Core mid-game Mining geography for Asgarnia ironmen. Not the highest AFK method forever, but the Falador metal-bank adjacency is permanent infrastructure value.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Hard Asgarnia. Boost rules still apply unless League overrides skill gates.

activity_additions.name: Mining Guild resource dungeon

unlocks: 5 luminite rocks and 4 drakolith rocks

activity_additions.name: Living Rock Caverns

70 Mining concentrated coal / 80 Mining concentrated gold
85 Fishing cavefish / 90 Fishing rocktail (living minerals bait from living rock remains)
Combat readiness or magic golem / shark outfit for creature tolerance
unlocks: Concentrated coal and gold deposits (multi-ore swings; stone-spirit scaling)
Cavefish and rocktail fishing spots
Living minerals from mining living rock remains
Farli pulley-lift bank deposit (including ore box dump)
activity_additions.notes: Classic ironman Mining/Fishing destination inside Asgarnia. Aggressive living rock protectors/strikers interrupt AFK without tolerance outfits. Official world 83 is social convenience only.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Asgarnia owns LRC. Tolerance outfits and food supply may pull other regions.

Optional payments to Elstan or flower protection

unlocks: Disease-free herb patch (My Arm protects for free)

activity_additions.name: Family Crest cooking and smelting gauntlets
requirements: Family Crest completed (starts with Dimintheis in south-east Varrock)
Normal game skill suggestions include 40 Crafting / Mining / Smithing; combat path or deathtouched dart for Chronozon
unlocks: Cooking gauntlets (reduced fish burn chance; can contribute sous chef 1% mitts set bonus if owned)
Smelting gauntlets (smelted bars go to metal bank; Make-X up to 60; Superheat Item metal-bank mode inside Artisans' Workshop)
Chaos gauntlets (combat bolt-spell path — not a skilling priority)
Ability to own all three pairs with paid re-enchant paths
activity_additions.notes: Quest is Misthalin-started; Boot/Dwarven Mine step and Artisans Workshop synergy make this a must-list for Asgarnia smithing audits. Smelting gauntlets pair with Asgarnia metal bank + Artisans Superheat workflows. After 12 Aug 2024, Family Crest is no longer required to store silver/gold in ore box/metal bank — gauntlets remain the burn/smelt QoL unlock.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Quest auto-completion may grant gauntlets without walking the quest. Keep Misthalin as quest region; Asgarnia is the practical Artisans synergy region, not the quest start.

equipment_additions.name: Factory outfit (Flash Powder Factory)
